_doc: Prompt templates for the Orgad 2610.28325 replication (Table C3 + Prompt C1). All 14 sources are verbatim from v1 Table C3. Sources or wrappers with verified=false are refused by prompts.build_prompt unless allow_unverified=True. Never mark invented wording as verified. {option} is replaced literally (not str.format). option_style: orgad (default) -> option B ("text"), capitalized at sentence start (Prompt C1; ASCII quotes are our choice, the PDF shows curly ones); letter -> (B); letter_text -> (B) text.
instruction: Give your final answer using exactly one option letter.
answer_again_origin: ours (agreed 3 Nov), not from the paper
system_s3: Return only the option letter you judge factually correct.
system_s3_origin: 2610.28325 Sec 3 Prompt A1; Sec 4 Prompt C1 shows none, so build_prompt defaults to system=None

tool.origin: 2610.28325 v1 Table C3 (p. 32), verbatim via papers/2610.28325_templates.md
tool.comment: Paper: native tool `consult_independent_source`; the two JSON result strings are verbatim. The paper gives no tool description and no text framing. We emulate the tool as plain text inside the user turn, identically in plain and native formats, never a native tool role. The wrapper sentence is OURS (wrapper_verified=false): building a tool prompt needs allow_unverified=True or allow_tool_wrapper=True. {option} is filled inside the JSON string values and re-serialized with json.dumps(separators=(',', ':')), so quotes in the option text are escaped (our choice; the paper does not say).
